description: Land Acquisition - Kumbutu Kuliya, Arachchikattuwa D/S Division, Puttalam District - Pitipana-North, Niyagama D/S Division, Galle District - Serapiswattha, Polgahawela D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Amendment to the Land Redemption Notice Published in the Gaz. Ex. No. 2059/21 of 20.02.2018
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains specific orders for acquiring servitude rights and taking possession of lands for public purposes (waste water disposal system and other land acquisitions), including detailed descriptions of land parcels, boundaries, and extents. While it mentions a government minister (Gayantha Karunatilleke), the core content is exclusively about land/property matters rather than government structure, personnel changes, or portfolio responsibilities.
